turns.content: So, why are they the strongest fits? Don't just repeat the descriptions

Here are the same ten companies, ranked. Your top ten: Nixo, Halyard Security, Tensorgate and Shiftwell, all on the same score at 10; then Clearwater Assurance at 9.5; then Tangible and F2, level at 9.4; then Ajopot at 8.8; then Spheros at 8.6; then Watchly at 8.2. Cards are up; want the detail on any of them?

Nixo, Halyard Security, Tensorgate and Shiftwell are tied on mandate fit at 10: 5 of 7 measures known for each, and no source documents yet. That's how well they match your mandate, not a judgement of quality.
Show me the ones that are pre-revenue, but have like unusually strong reasons to be interesting

None of the ten companies I just showed are pre-revenue, so I looked wider. Of the 23 companies closest to your mandate that I checked, I can't show you any that are pre-revenue. For Nixo, Tangible, F2, Ajopot, Spheros and Watchly and nine more, whether they have revenue isn't on record, so I've left them out rather than guess; unknown isn't the same as no.
So, are there any promising opportunities outside my preferred sectors worth a look?... You can keep them separate from my normal matches

Of the 47 companies on Capital Q I checked, I can't show you any that are pre-revenue and are outside your preferred sectors. For Abodely, Abodely Hub, Abodeeon Systems, Abodeio Technologies, Afyascan and Agroova Africa and ten more, their revenue and sector aren't on record against this, so I've left them out rather than guess; unknown isn't the same as no.
